result.title: FGSCalib: Targetless Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Calibration from Foreground Segmentation
result.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, and 4 pages of supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/zsungi/fgscalib
result.summary: Camera-LiDAR pairs installed as fixed infrastructure need periodic recalibration, but a calibration target takes the installation out of service. We present FGSCalib, a targetless method that calibrates a stationary camera-LiDAR pair from the objects moving in its view. We only assume that arbitrary moving objects are present in the scene: each sensor separates the moving foreground from the static background, without relying on object classes. With the correct extrinsic, the LiDAR foreground points project onto the camera foreground. FGSCalib turns the camera mask into a boundary-proximity field and finds the extrinsic by two-stage simulated annealing over selected frame pairs. It needs no measured initial extrinsic (random starts give similar results) and works with both rotating and non-repetitive LiDARs. We evaluate it on 21 simulated scenarios with exact ground truth and on 72 real ones (nine camera-LiDAR pairs in eight scenes), with a reference averaged from 43 manual calibrations. In simulation the median error is 5.3 cm and 0.19°. On real data we use a tolerance of 18 cm and 1.8°, met by 93% of single manual calibrations. Keeping the lowest-cost of five runs, FGSCalib meets it in 51 of the 72 scenarios: in 20 of 24 with the Livox, where the strongest of five baselines reaches 11, and in 31 of 48 with the two rotating LiDARs, where only one baseline estimate does. Its median error is 9.5 cm and 0.9°, against 7.3 cm and 0.7° for a single manual calibration. The code and the dataset are available online.

AI.brief_summary: FGSCalib 提出一种无标定板、无初始外参的相机-LiDAR 外参标定方法：利用场景中运动前景的掩码构造边界邻近场，通过两阶段模拟退火搜索使 LiDAR 前景点投影与相机前景对齐。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作是传感器几何外参标定，核心是前景掩码与点云投影的低层几何对齐，不涉及视觉推理状态、证据使用或训练监督，与 LVR 主线缺少可具体核查的借鉴线索。
